card.name: Undiagnosed bleeding in contraindication lists
card.fires_on: The ending of the word "Undiagnosed" ("osed", or "agn" when split differently) at the start of a contraindication item. It is nearly always followed by abnormal genital, vaginal or uterine bleeding in estrogen or hormone labels.

modes.label: Undiagnosed after split
modes.description: The "osed" piece completing "Undiagn" in a list of contraindications.

card.writes: It promotes words for mysterious, unknown or unexplained, which fits the sense of "undiagnosed".
card.plain: It fires on the word "undiagnosed" in hormone-therapy contraindication lists, just before "abnormal bleeding".
